steps.title: Set up the project
steps.describe: Create the project folder, set it up as an ES module, install Deva Core, and lay out the files you will fill in.
learn: Create a folder and run npm init.
Set "type": "module" in package.json.
Install @indra.ai/deva.
Create index.js and the data folder.

steps.title: The client file
steps.describe: Write client.json, which describes who is talking to the Deva.
learn: The name, describe, copyright and DATA wrapper.
DATA.id, DATA.key and DATA.VLA.
DATA.prompt with its emoji, text and colors.
DATA.profile.
DATA.features, each with concerns, global and devas.

steps.title: The agent file
steps.describe: Write agent.json, which describes who the Deva is, including its vars and its own context labels.
learn: The wrapper, with VLA at the top level and DATA beneath it.
DATA.id, DATA.key and DATA.prompt.
DATA.profile.
DATA.vars with a plain value and the vars.context map.

steps.title: Wire it together
steps.describe: Import the client and agent files, build the info block from your package.json, and create the Deva.
learn: Filling in id, description and copyright in package.json with npm pkg set.
Importing JSON with {type:'json'}.
Building info from package.json.
Passing agent and vars to new Deva().

steps.title: Give it skills
steps.describe: Add one func, one method and one listener, and see when to use each.
learn: A func for internal work, called inside the Deva as this.func.greet().
A method the Deva can be asked to run, called as /hello.
A listener that reacts to the devacore:question event.
Why all three are bound to the Deva when it starts.

steps.title: Bring it to life
steps.describe: Call init(client), watch the Deva reach ready, ask it a question, and read the stamped packet that comes back.
learn: What happens between init(client) and ready.
What the ready hash marks.
Asking a question and reading the packet.
Checking the md5, sha256 and sha512 stamps.

steps.title: Shut it down
steps.describe: Stop the Deva cleanly with stop() and see what it answers once it is offline.
learn: Calling stop().
What a stopped Deva answers.
